text:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU pool gpool-eu-west at 95% capacity, request queue length 1,820, avg token throttle 41%. Autoscaler attempted to add instances but failed to reach target (max 48 instances).

deploy-bot: Deploy v21.3 completed to canary/promo at 2026-03-15T09:20Z. Patch includes kv-cache prefix pruning change and longer default context (max_ctx 20480 -> 32768).

sre-oncall-zoe: I'm on it — digging into pool metrics. Seeing a sudden jump in avg_seq_length and KV cache miss growth around 09:22Z.

infra-raj: Confirmed. KV cache entries per model instance jumped x3. Memory accounts show per-GPU memory usage up ~28%. Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts hitting provider quota limit.

ml-raj: That rollout included a default context increase and changed kv eviction policy to keep longer prefixes for multi-turn safety. This would increase KV footprint. We didn't expect 3x on live traffic.

support-amy: Customer support: a handful of high-volume customers (acct: fluxai, acct: dockit) are reporting 503s and long tail latencies. Est. impacted sessions ~1200 active at peak.

pm-lina: What's our immediate mitigation? Can we rollback?

sre-oncall-zoe: Two immediate mitigations in parallel: 1) throttle non-critical tenants via routing rules (reduce new sessions), 2) rollback v21.3 Canary -> previous model on the host ring. Need deploy approval.

infra-raj: Provider quota for maximum machines (48) is the hard cap at the moment. I can request emergency quota but that's >30min.

ml-raj: Rollback looks safest and fastest. How long to flip traffic?

deploy-bot: Canary -> stable rollback plan: run deploy rollback job: `rbctl rollback release v21.3 --target canary --force`. Estimated 3-5 minutes to redirect traffic, 15-20 minutes to warm caches.

sre-oncall-zoe: Doing the rollback now. I'll coordinate and watch queues.

(2m later)

sre-oncall-zoe: `rbctl` executed. Canary traffic is being mapped back to v21.2. Observability: queue length down from 1820 -> 900 within 90s. Token throttle down to 22%.

ml-raj: Good. Note we'll still have warmup backlog as older sessions on v21.3 finish. Need to limit new long-context requests.

ops-bot: Rule applied: non-critical route `generation.experimental` rate limit set to 30r/s for 10m.

support-amy: Notifying top impacted customers with a brief note: "We're experiencing throttling; we've rolled back a recent model change and are mitigating. ETA 30m." Sending now.

pm-lina: Please also flag internal stakeholders and legal if SLOs breached.

infra-raj: Provider approved an extra 12 instances as emergency, but bringing them up will take ~7m. Since we rolled back we've avoided that for now. Keep the request in flight in case queue spikes again.

sre-oncall-zoe: Current status: queue 420, throttle 12%, pool utilization 86%. We're monitoring; will keep throttles in place until KV cache stabilizes.

ml-raj: We should revert the kv eviction policy change from the rollout branch and re-run a smaller canary with a traffic mirrored test to measure memory footprint. Also revert the default context bump — keep as opt-in.

infra-raj: Agreed. I'll open an infra follow-up to adjust autoscaler soft limits and add a faster cold-start warmup path to reduce warmup pressure.

support-amy: Customers updated: fluxai confirmed reduced errors; dockit still saw a few 502s but is stable now. They want postmortem.

pm-lina: Assigning postmortem lead: @ml-raj for root cause (config change), @sre-oncall-zoe for ops timeline, @infra-raj for capacity/autoscale actions.

ml-raj: I'll draft the impact summary and include specific config diffs: `kv_eviction: longest-prefix -> keep-last-n-turns` and `default_max_context: 20480 -> 32768`.

sre-oncall-zoe: Quick notes for postmortem: cause = rollout config increased per-request memory; effect = sustained KV growth -> per-GPU mem spike -> autoscaler hit provider limit -> queue growth -> request throttling and customer errors. Mitigation = emergency rollback, per-route throttles, emergency quota request, gradual canary re-eval.

infra-raj: Action items (short): 1) add autoscaler ramp guard to prevent simultaneous scale beyond N instances until warmup completes, 2) automated rollback if queue growth > 1000 for 5m post-deploy, 3) provider quota request template + on-call escalation path.

ml-raj: Action items (short): 1) make default context opt-in per deployment flag, 2) add offline memory regression test for kv footprint, 3) smaller canary footprint with traffic mirror before promotion.

support-amy: I'll collect customer impact details and attach logs. Two customers asked for credit; will route to billing after postmortem.

pm-lina: ETA for preliminary incident report?

sre-oncall-zoe: Sending a short incident summary in 45m with metrics and timelines.

deploy-bot: Post-deploy checks: auto-rollback trigger disabled for this rollout (override=true) — will add a safeguard to disallow overrides for config-sensitive changes.

ml-raj: Noted. We also need to add a linting check on model rollout diffs that change `default_max_context` or kv eviction semantics.

sre-oncall-zoe: Closing live incident loop: system stabilized, queue trending down. We'll remain on watch for 1 hour and then transition to async follow-up. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

support-amy: I'll stitch customer notes and publish to the incident channel once the postmortem is ready.

pm-lina: Thanks team.

(End of thread)
